title: Two Points on the Stone
sceneText:
It gets light late. There is frost on the window glass, and the line of the hills to the north sits low in a layer of grey, as though it had already begun to come down over there.

The two points on the stone yesterday, an inch apart. When you close your eyes they are still where he drew them.

It is a full day’s walk. Thierry said: if you want to go, tell me.

The wheat in the fields is not all in. The last three days of accounts are spread on the desk, and nobody will do them for you.

effects.logEntry: You did not wait for the harvest to be in. You went to Thierry that same day.
You decided it would wait until the harvest was in.

choices.resultText:
You say after the harvest.

As you say it you are looking out of the window. The frost on the glass is going back, a little at a time.

Today’s work is in the fields.
